releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.4.2

- Automatically repairs duplicate Bike Sync-managed calendar workouts before load and recovery are calculated.
- Removes orphaned weather replacements when no real matching outdoor workout exists.
- Allows only one managed weather replacement per ride and date.
- Preserves manual events, subscribed calendar notes, races, and third-party activities during repair.
- Reloads Intervals.icu after cleanup so false planned load no longer distorts Fatigue or Form.
